in_marathi.name: Indal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indal derives from the Sanskrit word 'indra-dal', meaning 'power of Indra'. Indra is the Hindu god of thunder, rain, and power. Therefore, Indal represents strength, resilience, and radiance, symbolizing the power of the divine to overcome challenges.
